name: Absolute Non-Refundable Fee Forfeiture
pattern: fee.*(non-refundable|cannot be claimed|forfeited in full).*even if.*(leaves|quits|discontinues)
reason: Complete retention of tuition fees for unrendered future educational services is declared an unfair trade practice by the Supreme Court of India.
legalSource: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 & Supreme Court ruling in Islamic Academy of Education v. State of Karnataka (2003)
caveat: Institutes can retain proportionate processing fees, but holding full multi-year fees is unlawful.

name: Retention of Original Educational Certificates
reason: Withholding original educational certificates as security or ransom is strictly prohibited under UGC and statutory guidelines.
legalSource: UGC Notification on Refund of Fees and Non-retention of Original Certificates (Sec 5)
caveat: Institutes may inspect originals for verification, but keeping custody is punishable.
